description: mHC stream collapse variants (threads and rows a block, columns a thread, load width and order, grid order, persistent grids, blocks an SM capped by reserved shared memory) against TileKernels' mhc_pre_apply_mix_fwd, per call at decode c1/c16 and 8K/16K prefill; each variant first checked bit for bit against TileKernels and across batch sizes. Includes round 1's 128-thread collapse (vLLM tilelang-mhc-post) and TileKernels' shape (d781f2a04), each SASS-identical to the measured kernel.
